notes.title: v0.5.1 Update
notes.content: [h3][b]Server Maintenance Notice[/b][/h3][p]The Asia, Europe, and North America servers will undergo maintenance at [b]UTC \[08:00][/b], with an expected downtime of [b]5 minutes[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Battle Interface Improvements[/b]: Enhanced the display of combat targets on the right side of the battle screen for clearer and more intuitive information presentation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill Description Adjustments[/b]: Refined the text descriptions of certain hero skills to ensure greater accuracy and readability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Armored Ancient Tree[/b]'s skill effect behaved abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Wreckage Instructor[/b]'s skills remained active after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue with unclear color display for the [b]Zerg Priest[/b]'s skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a bug where [b]Genetic Contamination[/b] incorrectly activated in the first round.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed persistent flickering in the [b]Minion Details[/b] interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the layering of the [b]Emote System[/b] to prevent obstruction of key UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the [b]New Player Tutorial[/b] experience by disabling unintended scroll wheel inputs and fixing an abnormal critical hit issue with [b]Skeleton Warriors[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect sorting logic for [b]Deck Costs[/b] during battles.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support and feedback! We will continue to optimize the gaming experience. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact us through official channels.[/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][b]Shark Studio[/b][/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the [b]Armored Ancient Tree[/b]'s skill effect behaved abnormally.
- Fixed a bug where [b]Wreckage Instructor[/b]'s skills remained active after death.
- Resolved an issue with unclear color display for the [b]Zerg Priest[/b]'s skills.
- Corrected a bug where [b]Genetic Contamination[/b] incorrectly activated in the first round.
- Fixed persistent flickering in the [b]Minion Details[/b] interface.
- Adjusted the layering of the [b]Emote System[/b] to prevent obstruction of key UI elements.
- Improved the [b]New Player Tutorial[/b] experience by disabling unintended scroll wheel inputs and fixing an abnormal critical hit issue with [b]Skeleton Warriors[/b].
- Fixed incorrect sorting logic for [b]Deck Costs[/b] during battles.
